description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 主题插件：Bloom 莫兰迪配色 4 变体，OKLCH 调色，明暗双主题，顶栏一键切换，全部达 WCAG AA

Bloom Morandi theme: ten variants (mist, cinnabar, petal, ripple, sage, stone, lapis, amber, aurora, lavender) built on OKLCH so light and dark stay perceptually even, switchable from the top bar, with all 20 foreground/background pairs measured at WCAG AA or better.
description.zh: Bloom 莫兰迪主题：十款变体（雾蓝 mist、朱砂 cinnabar、花瓣 petal、涟漪 ripple、鼠尾草 sage、暖石 stone、青金 lapis、琥珀 amber、极光 aurora、薰衣草 lavender）基于 OKLCH 调色，明暗切换不跳变，顶栏一键切换，20 组「主色 + 底色」实测全部达到 WCAG AA。

description.en: Prompt Presets to manage your library
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理常用提示词库，一键注入到输入框，快速复用你的提示词模板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for visualizing, arranging, branching, merging, and summarizing AI agent sessions on an interactive graph canvas

The rich `edit` tool for DeepSeek Harness (replace / patch / apply_patch / hashline modes) with embedded format-on-write and diagnostics — a standalone plugin with no upstream harness changes required.
